title: Weighted averages of $x_i$
idea: A weighted average $\bar{x} = \sum_i w_i x_i$ mixes values by importance.
compute: function compute(p) { var n = p.n; var x = []; for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) x.push(p.mode === 'sq' ? (i+1)*(i+1) : i+1); var a = p.a.map(function(v){ var s = Math.pow(Math.max(v,0), p.sharp); return p.square ? s*s : s; }); var tot = a.reduce(function(s,v){return s+v;},0); var w = tot > 0 ? a.map(function(v){return v/tot;}) : a.map(function(){return 1/n;}); var contrib = w.map(function(v,i){return v*x[i];}); var mean = contrib.reduce(function(s,v){return s+v;},0); var xs=[], ys=[]; for (var t=0;t<=20;t++){ xs.push(t/5); ys.push(Math.pow(t/5, p.sharp)); } return { x: x, w: w, contrib: contrib, mean: mean, total: tot, labels: x.map(function(v,i){return 'item '+(i+1);}), M: p.M, xs: xs, ys: ys, warning: tot > 0 ? null : 'All weights are zero, so equal weights are used.' }; }
